issues.display_title: Issue #1699: Clean up unused search page and associated dead code
issues.main_description_html:
Goal: Remove the search page and all associated dead code.

Analysis of Dead Code to Remove:

  1. Frontend UI (Search Component)
    • src/app/pages/search/search.component.html
    • src/app/pages/search/search.component.scss
    • src/app/pages/search/search.component.ts
  2. Frontend Routing
    • src/app/routes/app-features.routes.ts: Remove the lazy-loaded route for search.
  3. Frontend Service
    • src/app/shared/services/main.service.ts: Remove the search() method (only used by the search component).
  4. Backend Route
    • server.ts: Remove the /api/search endpoint and the import for API/search.ts.
  5. Backend API Logic
    • API/search.ts: Delete file (unused after endpoint removal).

All code paths are strictly isolated to the search feature. No shared dependencies will break.

QA Tester Summary

Status: Bug / Not Passed
Date: 2026-07-17
Suite: qa_testing/tests/e2e/server-cleanup/issue_1699_search_cleanup.spec.ts
Issue: #1699
Task: Clean up unused search page and associated dead code

Executive Summary

The main search feature files listed in the task were removed, but the cleanup is not complete from the user-facing/runtime side. The app still treats /search as a meaningful route through SEO metadata and reserved-route logic, then renders the profile/gallery shell in a loading state. The removed backend endpoint /api/search also still returns a successful HTML SSR app shell because it falls through to server.get('*').

This means the code deletion is only partially done: the explicit component/API code is gone, but stale search route behavior and stale metadata are still visible on the real dev site.

Acceptance Checklist

Task Requirement QA Result Evidence
Remove src/app/pages/search/search.component.html PASS File absent
Remove src/app/pages/search/search.component.scss PASS File absent
Remove src/app/pages/search/search.component.ts PASS File absent
Remove lazy-loaded search route from src/app/routes/app-features.routes.ts PASS No path: 'search' found
Remove search() method from src/app/shared/services/main.service.ts PASS No search() method found
Remove /api/search endpoint and API/search.ts import from server.ts PASS No /api/search route/import found
Delete API/search.ts PASS File absent
Remove all associated dead code FAIL Search SEO entry, reserved route segment, and translations still remain
Real dev /search should no longer behave like an active Search page FAIL /search title is still Search - Villume and page renders profile/gallery loading shell
Real dev /api/search should no longer behave like a successful endpoint FAIL /api/search returns HTTP 200 HTML app shell

Result

  • PASS - Search component files are removed from src/app/pages/search/.
  • PASS - API/search.ts is removed.
  • PASS - src/app/routes/app-features.routes.ts no longer has a lazy-loaded search route.
  • PASS - src/app/shared/services/main.service.ts no longer has a search() method.
  • PASS - server.ts no longer declares /api/search or imports API/search.ts.
  • FAIL - Search cleanup is incomplete because search-specific SEO/reserved-route/translation leftovers still exist.
  • FAIL - Real dev /search still renders a page titled Search - Villume and shows the profile/gallery shell in a loading state instead of a 404/removed route.
  • FAIL - Real dev /api/search returns HTTP 200 text/html, meaning the removed API path falls through to the SSR app shell instead of being clearly gone.

Summary Code Review

  • Removed correctly:
    • src/app/pages/search/search.component.html, .scss, and .ts are absent.
    • API/search.ts is absent.
    • src/app/routes/app-features.routes.ts has no path: 'search' entry.
    • src/app/shared/services/main.service.ts has no search() method.
    • server.ts has no /api/search endpoint or API/search.ts import.
  • Still present / incomplete:
    • src/app/shared/seo/page-seo.config.ts:68 still defines PAGE_SEO.search.
    • src/app/shared/seo/page-seo.config.ts:69 still sets the removed page title to Search - Villume.
    • src/app/shared/seo/page-seo.config.ts:103 still includes 'search' in RESERVED_FIRST_SEGMENTS.
    • src/assets/i18n/en.json:9 still contains "t_search": "Search".
    • src/assets/i18n/fr.json:8 still contains "t_search": "Chercher".
  • Routing behavior detail:
    • src/app/app.routes.ts:44 registers profileParamRoutes before the wildcard.
    • src/app/routes/profile.routes.ts:52 defines path: ':username', so /search can still be consumed as a dynamic profile username after the explicit search route is removed.
    • src/app/shared/seo/seo.service.ts applies resolvePageSeo() for non-profile routes; because search remains in SEO config, the browser title still becomes Search - Villume.
  • Server behavior detail:
    • server.ts:117 has the SSR catch-all server.get('*'). With no /api/search endpoint and no API 404 guard, /api/search falls through to SSR and returns HTTP 200 HTML.

Real Data / Runtime Evidence

Check URL Observed
Removed page route https://dev.villume.com/search HTTP app page renders with title Search - Villume; visible content is Galleries, Information, Loading...
Removed API route https://dev.villume.com/api/search HTTP 200, content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8, SSR HTML app shell
Screenshot/video environment DISPLAY2 left Browser address bar visible at dev.villume.com/search

Impact

  • Users or crawlers can still access /search and see a broken/stale profile-gallery loading shell.
  • SEO metadata still advertises a removed Search page.
  • /api/search returning HTTP 200 HTML can mislead monitoring, crawlers, QA, or consumers into thinking the removed API route is still valid.
  • The cleanup may look complete in source-only review but remains incomplete on real dev runtime.

Root Cause Hypothesis

  • Removing the explicit search component/route did not account for shared route infrastructure:
    • SEO config still has search.
    • Reserved route logic still knows about search.
    • Dynamic profile route :username can consume /search.
    • Express SSR catch-all can consume /api/search after the route is deleted.

White / Gray / Black Box

  • White box:
    • Confirmed the specific files and methods listed in the issue were removed.
    • Confirmed remaining dead code in SEO config, reserved route set, and translations.
    • Confirmed route ordering allows /search to be treated as a dynamic profile path.
  • Gray box:
    • Real dev API request to /api/search returns HTTP 200 HTML SSR shell instead of a removed/404 API response.
    • This is caused by server catch-all behavior, not by the old API/search.ts file still existing.
  • Black box:
    • Real browser opens /search with clean address bar.
    • The page still shows Search metadata and a profile/gallery loading shell, so the removed page is not cleanly removed from the user-facing route behavior.

Confusion Matrix

Category Expected Observed Count Result
Issue-listed source cleanup Removed Removed 7 True Positive
Associated dead-code cleanup Removed Still present 3 False Negative
/search runtime route Removed / 404 / no stale Search behavior Still renders stale Search/profile shell 1 False Negative
/api/search runtime route Removed / 404 / non-success API behavior HTTP 200 HTML SSR shell 1 False Negative
Server crash No crash No crash 0 True Negative

Test Execution

  • Playwright result: failed as expected for bug confirmation.
  • Failed assertions: leftover Search SEO metadata, leftover t_search translations, /api/search returns 200 HTML, /search keeps Search metadata and profile shell instead of 404.
  • Real-site recording: Chrome on DISPLAY2 left (X=-1920, Y=0, 1920x1080) with address bar visible.
  • Video sanity check: extracted frame confirms dev.villume.com/search in the address bar and the gallery/profile loading shell on screen.

Actual Failed Assertions

  • hasSearchSeoEntry expected false, received true.
  • hasSearchTranslations expected false, received true.
  • /api/search expected not 200, received 200.
  • /api/search expected not text/html, received text/html; charset=utf-8.
  • /search title expected not to match Search, received Search - Villume.
  • /search body expected 404 or not found, received profile/gallery shell text.

Evidence

Screenshot:

Video:

issue-1699-search-route-addressbar-display2-left.mp4

Recommendation

  • Remove the search entry from PAGE_SEO.
  • Remove stale t_search translation keys if no remaining UI references them.
  • Decide desired route behavior for /search:
    • If removed page should show not-found: add an explicit search -> 404 route before profileParamRoutes.
    • If /search should be allowed as a username slug: remove it from RESERVED_FIRST_SEGMENTS and avoid applying Search SEO metadata.
  • Add an API 404 guard/fallback before server.get('*') so removed /api/* endpoints do not return successful SSR HTML.
  • Re-test:
    • /search no longer has title Search - Villume.
    • /search no longer shows stuck Galleries/Profile loading shell.
    • /api/search no longer returns 200 text/html.

issues.display_title: Issue #1703: Refactor root layout to app-layouts and fix double layer .dash-main nesting
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Refactored the application layout structure to fix the double .dash-main class nesting issue (e.g., on the /:username and settings/ routes), while keeping the layout consistent with pages like /:username/info.

Changes Made

  • Simplified app.component.ts: Removed layout wrappers (Header, Footer, DashShell) from the root. The template now only contains <router-outlet>.
  • Centralized LayoutsComponent: Moved all global layouts (Header, Footer, DashShell, Alert Message) into <app-layouts>.
  • Fixed DashShellComponent: Converted app-dash-shell to use <ng-content> instead of <router-outlet>, decoupling it from routing.
  • Fixed ng-content Projection Bug: Used <ng-template #projectedContent> and ngTemplateOutlet to conditionally project the content inside either app-dash-shell or the standard layout-shell. This fixes the blank screen issue for pages without sidemenu by avoiding duplicate ng-content slots.
  • InformationComponent: Updated to use <app-layouts> properly.

QA Tester Summary

Status: Bug / Not Passed
Date: 2026-07-17
Suite: qa_testing/tests/e2e/layout/issue_1703_root_layout_dash_main_nesting.spec.ts
Issue: #1703
Task: Refactor root layout to app-layouts and fix double .dash-main nesting

Executive Summary

QA confirmed most of the root-layout refactor is present: AppComponent now renders only <router-outlet>, LayoutsComponent owns the shared header/footer/dashboard shell, and DashShellComponent uses <ng-content> instead of <router-outlet>.

However, the issue is not fully passed because the real dev /:username route still renders nested .dash-main inside another .dash-main. The failing DOM shape was detected on real data route https://dev.villume.com/testergothru:

  • app-dash-shell .dash-main count: 2
  • app-dash-shell .dash-main .dash-main nested count: 1
  • Affected checked route: /:username / profile-galleries

The /:username/info and /settings/profile routes passed the same runtime nesting check.

    • PASS: root no longer directly renders Header/Footer/DashShell wrappers.
  • src/app/layouts/layouts.component.html

    • PASS: no <router-outlet> remains inside DashShell.
